videos.name: hr-pay-run-walkthrough
videos.title: Monthly payroll run: period, run and approval screens

steps.caption: Goal: get this month's payroll ready. Start at HR → Payroll → Periods.
Add payroll period: a code, then Start date, End date and Payment date for the month.
You would click Save. We click Cancel in this video, so nothing changes.
Next, the Runs tab. Choose the open Payroll period and a Run date inside it.
Create run makes a DRAFT run. Only one active run is allowed per period.
Each run row shows its next steps as buttons. Auto-calculate shows a read-only preview — check Warnings, then Apply.
Then Finalize (it asks you to confirm). The run waits for a manager with status FINALIZED.
The manager opens the Approvals tab and clicks Approve or Reject (with a reason).
After approval: Post GL and Payslips on the run's row, Bank CSV, then lock the period on Periods.

videos.name: hr-pay-setup-tour
videos.title: Payroll setup: components and structure assignments

steps.caption: Goal: see how pay items are set up. Open HR → Leave & Payroll Setup → Salary components.
Component type: EARNING (adds to gross) or DEDUCTION (reduces net).
Calculation type decides the maths — here: rate × approved overtime hours.
You would click Save to finish. We click Cancel so nothing changes.
Structure assignments tab: link each employee to a salary structure from a start date.
Optional: Base salary override (gross / minimum wage base) and component overrides.
Workers without an assignment are skipped by Auto-calculate.
